response.text:
I can’t inspect or read the attached image in this session because no image-inspection tool is available. That means I cannot verify any visual details, objects, or the exact text on the safety sign you mention. I will not guess what the image shows.

I can help if you choose one of these next steps:

- Paste the sign text or type a short description of the image (colors, objects, where the sign is located). I’ll analyze and explain the meaning and any safety implications.
- Transcribe the sign text here (even roughly). I’ll proofread and interpret it and suggest any improvements or compliance concerns.
- Use your phone or computer to run OCR (text extraction) and paste the result here. Quick options:
  - iPhone: open Camera, point at sign, tap the Live Text / text-selection icon, copy text.
  - Android: Google Lens from the camera app or Google Photos → Lens → Text → Copy.
  - Desktop: upload the photo to Google Drive, right-click → Open with → Google Docs (it will OCR the image), or use free OCR services (e.g., OCR.space, Microsoft OneNote).
- If you want to re-photograph the sign for better OCR, follow these tips:
  - Fill the frame with the sign (crop out surrounding clutter).
  - Shoot straight-on (minimize tilt) and from short distance.
  - Use even lighting; avoid glare, reflections, and shadows.
  - Use the highest resolution available and ensure the photo is in focus.
  - If text is small, take a close-up or use zoom, and include the whole sign.

If you prefer, I can also list common warehouse safety sign texts and what they mean (examples: "Hard Hat Area," "Forklift Traffic," "Eye Protection Required," "Authorized Personnel Only," "Emergency Exit — Keep Clear"). Tell me which option you want and I’ll proceed.
